annotations.title: EXIF data: camera, date and GPS

description: EXIF data of a photo from its URL: camera make and model, lens, date taken, exposure, aperture, ISO, focal length, orientation, software and the GPS position (latitude, longitude, altitude) when it was recorded, with the image format, width and height. JPEG EXIF; PNG, GIF and WebP give size only. Up to 15 MB. Use to check where and when a photo was taken or to verify an upload. Example: url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ianare/exif-samples/master/jpg/gps/DSCN0010.jpg. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
